scope: Five base batches and five completed 20M panels plus nineteen prior followup queries. Pending Batch 05 new alternatives not counted. Mac, pilots and abandoned transition costs remain separate.
limits: Measured VM lifetimes priced at recorded rate, not billing. Mean scaling only; panel sizes, discovered alternatives and availability vary. Inclusive scenarios retain ancillary storage/transfer/operations and recovery assumptions. Cloud-stage timing excludes preflight, retrieval, review pauses and final synthesis.

calendar_estimate.basis: Retain the prior conditional Saturday 14 November Paris central estimate and late-Friday through Sunday window. Remaining cloud-stage work excludes preflight, retrieval, deeper alternatives, independent reviews and final synthesis; availability and scientific obligations can add time.
